The Barnacle is a member of the parasites focused on planting hidden barnacles in secret places. When they're killed, burrowers will burst out of all unbroken barnacles and begin flying towards the body in a straight line, gaining speed over time. If someone is in the path of the burrower, they will be turned into a Barnacle.
However, the individual barnacles are fairly weak and can be destroyed if found. Try to hide them behind secret walls and other barriers so that unsuspecting maints prowlers don't come upon them.
